arguments.message: Hi! After an import finishes, go to Settings → Data → Import history and click the run you just did. There you’ll see a per‑row list, and for every row that didn’t import it shows the reason (e.g., missing required field, malformed email, duplicate, etc.). Once you’ve fixed those rows you can re‑run the import on just the problematic rows instead of the whole file. Let me know if you need any more help!
